title: Noor and the Prom
author: Beatrix Pemberton
blurb: Vesper Vane, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
